premise: I cleared my daughter’s $105,000 medical-school debt on her sworn promise to be my power of attorney, but she forged a durable POA, drained my $340,000 IRA, and bought a no-seniors condo in another city; I exposed the fraud, won a $410,000 judgment, secured the suspension of her medical license, and now live in that condo renting rooms to nursing students while I teach a course called ‘Financial Defibrillation’ with her mugshot on the syllabus.
